import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c = np.cos(params[2]*t+params[3])
    return params[0] + params[1]*c - params[4]*x + params[5]/v + params[6]*c/v + params[7]*x**3 + params[8]*v + params[9]*x*v

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c = np.cos(params[2]*np.sqrt(t)+params[3])
    return params[0] + params[1]*c - params[4]*x + params[5]/v + params[6]*c/v + params[7]*x**3 + params[8]*v + params[9]*x*v
